title: Make sync_metrics.py write both metric blocks and splice non-destructively

reopened.reason: An independent code review falsified the 'never deletes content below the block it rewrites' acceptance criterion, which had already been checked off. The first receipt was withdrawn.
reopened.extra_bug_found_while_fixing: Repeated syncs appended one blank line per run; caught by the new idempotency test, not by the review.

verified_files.detail: Replaced the '## '-heading heuristic with sentinel comments (<!-- solorail:<name>:start/end -->) plus a fence-aware, any-heading-level fallback for migration. Added sentinel_tags, fenced_line_flags, find_block_bounds, wrap_block, is_orphan_sentinel, is_closed_sprint. Split cut vs active actual hours. CLOSED sprints are no longer rewritten.

Grew from 7 to 19 tests: one regression per review finding, plus sentinel migration and idempotency coverage. Two original tests had their expectations corrected for the intentional contract change (trailing blank line, new render_metrics_table signature).

definition_of_done.evidence: test_enforce_gate, test_check_worktree, test_compute_actual_hours unchanged and green

definition_of_done.criterion: sprint-02 Metrics agrees with the velocity summary
definition_of_done.evidence: 12.0h/0.5h and 0/8 in both blocks after live sync

definition_of_done.criterion: Section below the block survives at ANY heading level
definition_of_done.evidence: Fixture with '### Carryover Notes' and '# Appendix' below the summary: both survived a live sync. This is the criterion that failed before.

definition_of_done.criterion: Indented or fenced marker mention is not mistaken for the block
definition_of_done.evidence: Fixture with an indented '  ## Metrics' mention and a fenced '## Metrics': mention preserved, exactly one Total Hours row, stale 999.0h replaced, no orphaned fence

definition_of_done.criterion: Each block ends with a blank line
definition_of_done.evidence: Programmatic check: no heading in the output is preceded by a non-blank, non-sentinel line
md5 of sprint-01.md unchanged across a live sync; sync prints 'skipped sprint-01.md: Status CLOSED (frozen)'

definition_of_done.criterion: Repeated syncs idempotent, no orphaned sentinels
definition_of_done.evidence: Three consecutive live syncs hold sprint-02.md at 38 lines; orphan from the block rename was swept

defects_closed: Boundary scan only matched column-0 '## ', so '### ' and '# ' sections below the block were deleted
Start scan stripped the line while the boundary scan did not, letting an indented mention match as block start and produce two disagreeing tables
No fenced-code awareness: a '## ' inside ``` terminated the section and orphaned the fence delimiter
sync() rewrote CLOSED sprints unconditionally while running as a PostToolUse hook
render_velocity_summary omitted its trailing blank line, gluing the next heading onto the last bullet
Total Hours compared active-only Planned against cut-inclusive Actual; Issues Cut Planned was hardcoded to 0
Repeated syncs accumulated one blank line per run
doc_defects_closed: sprint-01-retro.md said E-03 was DRAFT awaiting plan-epic, contradicting ROADMAP.md in the same commit
The retro rewrite had deleted the only record of why telemetry reports 6/7 architected issues (E01-ISS-04 pivot-added without a spec receipt) and of the E02-ISS-01 worktree root cause; both restored
process_note: The first pass was marked DONE on a self-authored receipt whose central claim was never tested at other heading levels. The test that 'proved' the fix hand-supplied a newline the production renderer did not emit. Independent review caught both.
notes: Unblocks E03-ISS-05, which needs a PR section below the summary. E03-ISS-04 (carryover generation) depends on the '###' subsection fix. ADR-004 should be revisited: findings 1-3 trace to the heading heuristic the two-block design required, now replaced by sentinels.
